answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a refundable deposit tied to a verifiable cipher key, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. Like light through a prism, one real track record splits into observable signals: completed jobs, peer ratings, and uptime, while a fresh account sitting alone on a knoll has no history to hide behind. Newcomers earn trust gradually, and slashing the stake when an agent cheats makes mass forgery unprofitable.
